en: Zero and liftoff! The final liftoff of Atlantis!
zh: 零秒，發射！亞特蘭蒂斯號的最後一次發射！
ja: ゼロ、発射！アトランティスの最後の打ち上げです！
local: Zero and liftoff! The final liftoff of Atlantis!
native: Zero and liftoff! The final liftoff of Atlantis!

en: The NASA you know today, it was actually founded after the launch of the first scientific mission in space.
zh: 你所知道的 NASA，實際上是在太空首個科學任務發射後成立的。
ja: 現在のNASAは、実は最初の科学ミッションの打ち上げ後に設立されました。
local: The NASA you know today, it was actually founded after the launch of the first scientific mission in space.
native: The NASA you know today, it was actually founded after the launch of the first scientific mission in space.

en: After the Soviet Union successfully launched the first satellite ever to orbit the Earth,
zh: 蘇聯成功發射了首顆繞地球軌道的衛星之後，
ja: ソ連が初めて地球を周回する衛星の打ち上げに成功した後、
local: After the Soviet Union successfully launched the first satellite ever to orbit the Earth,
native: After the Soviet Union successfully launched the first satellite ever to orbit the Earth,

en: the United States was under enormous pressure to pick up the pace of its own satellite program.
zh: 美國面臨巨大壓力，要加快自己的衛星計劃進度。
ja: アメリカは自国の衛星計画のペースを上げる大きな圧力にさらされました。
local: the United States was under enormous pressure to pick up the pace of its own satellite program.
native: the United States was under enormous pressure to pick up the pace of its own satellite program.

en: Built by a team of more than 100 engineers, electronics experts, and machinists working around the clock,
zh: 由超過100名工程師、電子專家和技工日夜趕工打造，
ja: 100人以上のエンジニア、電子専門家、機械工が昼夜を問わず働いて作られ、
local: Built by a team of more than 100 engineers, electronics experts, and machinists working around the clock,
native: Built by a team of more than 100 engineers, electronics experts, and machinists working around the clock,

en: Explorer 1 became the first American satellite to orbit the Earth just four months later.
zh: 探險者1號成為美國首顆繞地球軌道的衛星，僅在四個月後發射成功。
ja: エクスプローラー1号はわずか4か月後にアメリカ初の地球周回衛星となりました。
local: Explorer 1 became the first American satellite to orbit the Earth just four months later.
native: Explorer 1 became the first American satellite to orbit the Earth just four months later.

en: In reality, Explorer 1 was actually the US's second attempt to launch the satellite into space after Sputnik first took flight.
zh: 事實上，探險者1號是美國在史普尼克首次飛行後第二次嘗試將衛星送入太空。
ja: 実際には、エクスプローラー1号はスプートニクの初飛行後、アメリカの2回目の衛星打ち上げの試みでした。
local: In reality, Explorer 1 was actually the US's second attempt to launch the satellite into space after Sputnik first took flight.
native: In reality, Explorer 1 was actually the US's second attempt to launch the satellite into space after Sputnik first took flight.

en: Working in tandem, the Jet Propulsion Laboratory and the Army Ballistic Missile Agency had a rocket nearly ready to launch,
zh: 噴射推進實驗室與陸軍彈道導彈局合作，火箭幾乎準備好發射，
ja: ジェット推進研究所と陸軍弾道ミサイル局が協力し、打ち上げ準備がほぼ整ったロケットを持っていました。
local: Working in tandem, the Jet Propulsion Laboratory and the Army Ballistic Missile Agency had a rocket nearly ready to launch,
native: Working in tandem, the Jet Propulsion Laboratory and the Army Ballistic Missile Agency had a rocket nearly ready to launch,

en: but the Navy's Vanguard project was given the first opportunity to send their rocket into space.
zh: 但海軍的先鋒計劃獲得了首次將火箭送入太空的機會。
ja: しかし、海軍のヴァンガード計画が最初にロケットを宇宙に送る機会を与えられました。
local: but the Navy's Vanguard project was given the first opportunity to send their rocket into space.
native: but the Navy's Vanguard project was given the first opportunity to send their rocket into space.

en: Vanguard made it about two feet off the ground before exploding on the launch pad.
zh: 先鋒號火箭升空約兩英尺後就在發射台爆炸了。
ja: ヴァンガードは地上約2フィートまで上がったところで発射台で爆発しました。
local: Vanguard made it about two feet off the ground before exploding on the launch pad.
native: Vanguard made it about two feet off the ground before exploding on the launch pad.

en: The Eisenhower administration, eager to ease the anxieties of a nation deep into the Cold War,
zh: 艾森豪總統政府急於緩解深陷冷戰的國家焦慮，
ja: アイゼンハワー政権は、冷戦の深刻な不安を和らげるために急いでいました。
local: The Eisenhower administration, eager to ease the anxieties of a nation deep into the Cold War,
native: The Eisenhower administration, eager to ease the anxieties of a nation deep into the Cold War,

en: gave JPL and the Army just 90 days to finish and launch Explorer 1.
zh: 只給噴射推進實驗室和陸軍90天完成並發射探險者1號。
ja: JPLと陸軍にエクスプローラー1号の完成と打ち上げにわずか90日を与えました。
local: gave JPL and the Army just 90 days to finish and launch Explorer 1.
native: gave JPL and the Army just 90 days to finish and launch Explorer 1.

en: Think for a minute, what a different world it would be if Explorer 1 never happened.
zh: 想想看，如果探險者1號從未發射，世界會是多麼不同。
ja: 少し考えてみてください。もしエクスプローラー1号がなかったら、世界はどれほど違っていたでしょうか。
local: Think for a minute, what a different world it would be if Explorer 1 never happened.
native: Think for a minute, what a different world it would be if Explorer 1 never happened.

en: Save Vanguard successfully launched in December.
zh: 幸好先鋒號在十二月成功發射。
ja: 幸いにもヴァンガードは12月に無事打ち上げられました。
local: Save Vanguard successfully launched in December.
native: Save Vanguard successfully launched in December.

en: The Explorer 1 may have been turned off.
zh: 探險者1號可能已經被放棄了。
ja: エクスプローラー1号は中止されていたかもしれません。
local: The Explorer 1 may have been turned off.
native: The Explorer 1 may have been turned off.

en: There may have been less pressure to create a separate space agency, so we might not have NASA.
zh: 可能就沒有那麼大壓力成立獨立的太空機構，或許我們就沒有 NASA。
ja: 別の宇宙機関を作る圧力も少なかったかもしれず、そうするとNASAは存在しなかったかもしれません。
local: There may have been less pressure to create a separate space agency, so we might not have NASA.
native: There may have been less pressure to create a separate space agency, so we might not have NASA.

en: There's a lot of chance involved in all this.
zh: 這一切都涉及很多偶然因素。
ja: これらすべてには多くの偶然が関わっています。
local: There's a lot of chance involved in all this.
native: There's a lot of chance involved in all this.

en: Minutes, click past relentlessly.
zh: 時間不斷無情地流逝。
ja: 時間は容赦なく過ぎていきます。
local: Minutes, click past relentlessly.
native: Minutes, click past relentlessly.

en: The beams of powerful searchlights light up the missile.
zh: 強力探照燈的光束照亮了導彈。
ja: 強力なサーチライトの光がミサイルを照らします。
local: The beams of powerful searchlights light up the missile.
native: The beams of powerful searchlights light up the missile.

en: Truly the star of one of the greatest suspense dramas of our time.
zh: 這真是我們時代最精彩懸疑劇的主角。
ja: まさに私たちの時代の最大のサスペンスドラマの主役です。
local: Truly the star of one of the greatest suspense dramas of our time.
native: Truly the star of one of the greatest suspense dramas of our time.

en: Five, four, three, two, one.
zh: 五、四、三、二、一。
local: Five, four, three, two, one.
native: Five, four, three, two, one.

en: Find a man, find a man.
zh: 找人，找人。
ja: 人を探せ、人を探せ。
local: Find a man, find a man.
native: Find a man, find a man.

en: Find a man, find a man.
zh: 找人，找人。
ja: 人を探せ、人を探せ。
local: Find a man, find a man.
native: Find a man, find a man.

en: After Explorer 1 launched on January 31, 1958, the space race officially began.
zh: 1958年1月31日探險者1號發射後，太空競賽正式開始。
ja: 1958年1月31日にエクスプローラー1号が打ち上げられ、宇宙競争が正式に始まりました。
local: After Explorer 1 launched on January 31, 1958, the space race officially began.
native: After Explorer 1 launched on January 31, 1958, the space race officially began.

en: Explorer 1 played a huge symbolic role in galvanizing America's legacy in space,
zh: 探險者1號在激勵美國太空傳承中扮演了重要象徵角色，
ja: エクスプローラー1号はアメリカの宇宙における遺産を鼓舞する大きな象徴的役割を果たしました。
local: Explorer 1 played a huge symbolic role in galvanizing America's legacy in space,
native: Explorer 1 played a huge symbolic role in galvanizing America's legacy in space,

en: but its true scientific mission was a milestone unto itself.
zh: 但其真正的科學任務本身就是一個里程碑。
ja: しかし、その真の科学的使命はそれ自体が一つの画期的な出来事でした。
local: but its true scientific mission was a milestone unto itself.
native: but its true scientific mission was a milestone unto itself.

en: The instruments onboard made the first major scientific find of the space age.
zh: 搭載的儀器做出了太空時代的首次重大科學發現。
ja: 搭載された機器は宇宙時代の最初の重要な科学的発見をもたらしました。
local: The instruments onboard made the first major scientific find of the space age.
native: The instruments onboard made the first major scientific find of the space age.

en: A belt of radiation around the planet linked to the very survival of life on Earth.
zh: 環繞地球的輻射帶與地球生命的生存息息相關。
ja: 地球を取り巻く放射線帯は地球上の生命の存続に関係しています。
local: A belt of radiation around the planet linked to the very survival of life on Earth.
native: A belt of radiation around the planet linked to the very survival of life on Earth.

en: With Explorer 1, science moved into space, and we can finally address questions scientifically.
zh: 有了探險者1號，科學進入太空，我們終於能以科學方式解答問題。
ja: エクスプローラー1号とともに科学は宇宙へ進出し、ついに科学的に疑問に答えられるようになりました。
local: With Explorer 1, science moved into space, and we can finally address questions scientifically.
native: With Explorer 1, science moved into space, and we can finally address questions scientifically.

en: We've asked for millennia.
zh: 這是我們千年來一直在探問的問題。
ja: 私たちは何千年も問い続けてきました。
local: We've asked for millennia.
native: We've asked for millennia.

en: The launch of Explorer 1 60 years ago opened the floodgates for future scientific missions,
zh: 60年前探險者1號的發射為未來的科學任務打開了大門，
ja: 60年前のエクスプローラー1号の打ち上げは、将来の科学ミッションの扉を開きました。
local: The launch of Explorer 1 60 years ago opened the floodgates for future scientific missions,
native: The launch of Explorer 1 60 years ago opened the floodgates for future scientific missions,

en: positioning the U.S. to be a leader in space exploration.
zh: 使美國成為太空探索的領導者。
ja: アメリカを宇宙探査のリーダーに位置づけました。
local: positioning the U.S. to be a leader in space exploration.
native: positioning the U.S. to be a leader in space exploration.

en: There are 18 missions observing Earth right now, while another 36 are currently exploring our solar system and beyond.
zh: 目前有18個任務在觀測地球，另外36個任務正在探索我們的太陽系及更遠的地方。
ja: 現在、18のミッションが地球を観測し、さらに36のミッションが太陽系やその先を探査しています。
local: There are 18 missions observing Earth right now, while another 36 are currently exploring our solar system and beyond.
native: There are 18 missions observing Earth right now, while another 36 are currently exploring our solar system and beyond.

en: To date, the United States has successfully sent a crude mission to the Moon,
zh: 迄今為止，美國已成功送出一個粗糙的月球任務，
ja: これまでにアメリカは月への粗末なミッションを成功させ、
local: To date, the United States has successfully sent a crude mission to the Moon,
native: To date, the United States has successfully sent a crude mission to the Moon,

en: dispatched spacecraft to each planetary body in our solar system,
zh: 派遣太空船前往太陽系中的每個行星體，
ja: 太陽系の各惑星に宇宙船を送り出し、
local: dispatched spacecraft to each planetary body in our solar system,
native: dispatched spacecraft to each planetary body in our solar system,

en: and reached interstellar space.
zh: 並抵達了星際空間。
ja: そして星間空間に到達しました。
local: and reached interstellar space.
native: and reached interstellar space.

en: Just this year alone, there are eight missions launching, all made possible by the collaborative efforts of NASA,
zh: 僅今年就有八個任務發射，這都得益於 NASA 的合作努力，
ja: 今年だけで8つのミッションが打ち上げられ、すべてNASAの協力によって実現しています。
local: Just this year alone, there are eight missions launching, all made possible by the collaborative efforts of NASA,
native: Just this year alone, there are eight missions launching, all made possible by the collaborative efforts of NASA,

en: its partner agencies like NOAA, and other space agencies around the world.
zh: 以及其合作夥伴如 NOAA 和全球其他太空機構。
ja: NOAAのようなパートナー機関や世界中の他の宇宙機関も含まれています。
local: its partner agencies like NOAA, and other space agencies around the world.
native: its partner agencies like NOAA, and other space agencies around the world.

en: Even though it started like a national activity,
zh: 儘管它起初像是一項國家活動，
ja: それは国の活動として始まりましたが、
local: Even though it started like a national activity,
native: Even though it started like a national activity,

en: we've brought the world along, and it's an international activity in which you manage to get her,
zh: 我們帶領了全世界，這成為一項國際活動，讓你能夠參與其中，
ja: 私たちは世界を巻き込み、国際的な活動となり、あなたも参加できるようになりました。
local: we've brought the world along, and it's an international activity in which you manage to get her,
native: we've brought the world along, and it's an international activity in which you manage to get her,

en: transcends the boundaries, and really opens up views of the world in a way we could have never imagined.
zh: 超越了界限，真正以我們從未想像過的方式開啟了對世界的視野。
ja: 境界を超え、私たちが想像もしなかった方法で世界の見方を広げています。
local: transcends the boundaries, and really opens up views of the world in a way we could have never imagined.
native: transcends the boundaries, and really opens up views of the world in a way we could have never imagined.

en: Less than a lifetime ago, humankind barely left the limits of our own atmosphere.
zh: 不到一個世代前，人類幾乎沒有離開我們自己的大氣層。
ja: ほんの一世代前、私たちは自分たちの大気圏の限界をほとんど出ていませんでした。
local: Less than a lifetime ago, humankind barely left the limits of our own atmosphere.
native: Less than a lifetime ago, humankind barely left the limits of our own atmosphere.

en: Who then could have imagined that only 60 years later we would be touching the atmosphere of the sun,
zh: 誰能想到僅僅60年後，我們就會觸及太陽的大氣層，
ja: それからわずか60年後に私たちが太陽の大気に触れるとは誰が想像できたでしょうか。
local: Who then could have imagined that only 60 years later we would be touching the atmosphere of the sun,
native: Who then could have imagined that only 60 years later we would be touching the atmosphere of the sun,

en: arriving at the most distant object humans have ever explored,
zh: 抵達人類曾探索過的最遙遠天體，
ja: 人類がこれまで探査した中で最も遠い天体に到達し、
local: arriving at the most distant object humans have ever explored,
native: arriving at the most distant object humans have ever explored,

en: and launching the world's most powerful telescope to get a glimpse of the first galaxies born after the Big Bang.
zh: 並發射世界上最強大的望遠鏡，窺探大爆炸後誕生的第一批星系。
ja: そしてビッグバン後に誕生した最初の銀河を垣間見るために世界最強の望遠鏡を打ち上げました。
local: and launching the world's most powerful telescope to get a glimpse of the first galaxies born after the Big Bang.
native: and launching the world's most powerful telescope to get a glimpse of the first galaxies born after the Big Bang.

en: Humanities exploration of the universe will continue to expand,
zh: 人類對宇宙的探索將持續擴展，
ja: 人類の宇宙探査は今後も拡大し続けます。
local: Humanities exploration of the universe will continue to expand,
native: Humanities exploration of the universe will continue to expand,

en: from our home planet to the far reaches of interstellar space.
zh: 從我們的家園星球到遙遠的星際空間。
ja: 私たちの故郷の惑星から星間空間の果てまで。
local: from our home planet to the far reaches of interstellar space.
native: from our home planet to the far reaches of interstellar space.

en: But wherever NASA goes, one thing is certain.
zh: 但無論 NASA 前往何處，有一件事是肯定的。
ja: しかし、NASAがどこへ行こうとも、一つ確かなことがあります。
local: But wherever NASA goes, one thing is certain.
native: But wherever NASA goes, one thing is certain.

en: It won't be boring.
zh: 那絕不會無聊。
ja: それは退屈なものにはならないでしょう。
local: It won't be boring.
native: It won't be boring.
